defects.title: V1-RMD-287 event broadcasts orderId/tableId via Clients.All; targeted delivery chain (V1-RMD-289) not verified for access scope
defects.invariant: Order/table events must be delivered only to authorized recipients (serving staff for that table/order), not all connected clients.
defects.mechanism: low-A.md:53 and WaiterNotificationDispatch.cs:49 show Clients.All broadcast for orderId/tableId events. V1-RMD-289 is cited as the targeted delivery chain replacement. The source note says 'PII yok' but does not prove all recipients are authorized for that order/table. The HelpRequestHub.cs:23-32 documents the same Clients.All pattern and proposes narrowing delivery to explicit recipient groups. Tests in HelpRequestHttpTests.cs:20 and KitchenOperationsStore.NotificationDispatchTests.cs assert on hub.Clients.AllCalls, suggesting the broadcast pattern is still used and tested.
defects.acceptance: V1-RMD-289 targeted delivery chain is fully implemented and verified: events carry recipient identifiers (userIds, role+table assignment) and hub sends only to those connections. No Clients.All broadcast remains for order/table events.

limitations: Read-only analysis; cannot run the targeted delivery verification. V1-RMD-289 implementation status unknown — need to check if it replaces Clients.All or coexists. Tests still assert on Clients.AllCalls.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
